scope: Connect held NPC reveal to authoritative action choice, passing, forced-last timeout and real effects
authority: XIR.cs:406-454 and 1016-1078; NC303 Valid handlers; existing SEM-001/002 timeout policy
requirements: Only actual legal NPC action IDs are selectable; clients cannot supply validity or choose another NPC
Actor receives one generic submit-choice; all other viewers receive only public waiting metadata, no second nested action API
If another main-deck card exists, empty selection passes; timeout passes without RNG
Last NPC with legal actions is mandatory; timeout chooses a canonical sorted action with recorded seed RNG
No legal actions discards NPC and continues reveal; repeated empty NPCs converge to a window, a held monster or immediate-score deck exhaustion
Selecting an action enters its real handler, including target/payment/private-card/pet choices or damage/rescue/death, in one atomic command transaction
Every wait has 15 seconds; auto players act immediately without extending clocks; persistence retains original decisions
Reject corrupt choice bindings, forged event outcomes and stale/foreign/repeated commands; preserve 56 cards, 46 encounters and 34 heroes
boundaries: Monster effects and scoring execution are separate ready nodes; no fake resolution of a revealed monster
Production end-action remains gated until CS03-03D; existing browser E2E is not proof of a complete battle UI
No extension of supported NPC effect dependencies beyond NJ01/NJ07 contracts
